label: sec:categorical-dirac-operator-intro
html: This section combines the substrate parameter q, the connection abla, and the Reeb derivation \xi into a single first-order operator whose two limits recover the gauge and matter terms of the categorical action. The categorical Dirac operator interpolates between the full covariant derivative at q = 1 and its purely contact component \iota_\xi abla as q o \infty. This formula defines a unique morphism in \mathbf{C} once abla, q, and \xi are fixed. It is an algebraic first-order interpolation along the contact splitting rather than an analytic Connes spectral triple of the type constructed on \mathrm{SU}_q(2) by Partha Sarathi Chakraborty and Arupkumar Pal [chakraborty-pal2003] and by Ludwik Dąbrowski, Giovanni Landi, Andrzej Sitarz, Walter van Suijlekom, and Joseph C. Várilly [dabrowski-landi-sitarz-vansuijlekom-varilly2005].
